_nota: Un protocolo con fuente por escalon (H9). Texto de maqueta de la sesion Fable 4 (9-nov-2026); N lo aprueba o lo reescribe. Las cifras salen de earn/naos/empresa/evolucion/2026-11-09-limite/fable/ejemplos/naos-friccion-referencias.json (n-system).

tenderness.conducta: I say one line to someone I don't know: good morning, or a question about their dog.
tenderness.dato: Chicago commuters expected talking to a stranger to make the ride worse. The ones asked to try it rated their ride the most pleasant.
tenderness.fuente: Epley and Schroeder, Journal of Experimental Psychology: General, 2014
tenderness.limite: Commuters in one city. Read the room: a no is a complete answer.

emptiness.conducta: I sit for two minutes with nothing playing.
emptiness.dato: In a lab study of 24 people, a two minute silent pause slowed heart rate and breathing more than slow music did.
emptiness.limite: A small lab study. The pause sat between music tracks.

saturation.conducta: I give each social app ten minutes a day, then the phone goes face down.
saturation.dato: 143 students kept this limit for three weeks and reported less loneliness and depression than the group that scrolled as usual.
saturation.fuente: Hunt and colleagues, Journal of Social and Clinical Psychology, 2018
saturation.limite: One university, three weeks. A start, and no cure.

body.titulo: One slow breath: 4 in, 4 hold, 6 out
body.conducta: I breathe out for six seconds, two longer than I breathe in.
body.dato: One round takes 14 seconds, about four breaths a minute. A review of 15 studies ties slow breathing, under ten breaths a minute, to a steadier heart rhythm.
body.fuente: Zaccaro and colleagues, Frontiers in Human Neuroscience, 2018
body.limite: Sit down first. Never in water or while driving. Dizzy? Stop and breathe as usual. A small practice, not medical advice.

courtyard.conducta: I pick one small hard thing on Monday and keep it all week.
courtyard.dato: In a study of 96 people, a daily habit took between 18 and 254 days to feel automatic. Missing one day changed very little.
courtyard.fuente: Lally and colleagues, European Journal of Social Psychology, 2010
courtyard.limite: Self-chosen habits, a small sample. There is no fixed number of days.
